query: 承包商安全管理 承包商安全管理 衡量企业对外包服务商、承包商及临时工的安全管理深度。重点考察承包商的安全准入资质审核、专项安全培训、作业现场监督及违章问责机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：建立了完善的承包商安全评价与准入制度；强制执行开工前专项安全培训及技术交底；具备常态化的现场安全巡检记录，并有明确的承包商安全问责与黑名单制度。 • 1分（合格）：要求承包商具备基础安全资质并签署安全协议，提供了一次性的入场安全教育，但缺乏过程中的动态监督或系统的违章问责机制。 • 0分（不合格）：无承包商安全管理披露，或仅笼统提及“要求承包商注意安全”。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：管理机制覆盖 >80% 的外包作业、承包商单位或特种作业项目。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅针对“高危作业”进行管理而忽略了常规外包项目，或未说明具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 承包商安全管理 承包商准入 作业许可 安全交底 入场安全教育 现场安全巡检 承包商黑名单 外包作业安全 PTW contractor safety management contractor prequalification permit to work safety induction toolbox talk site safety inspection contractor blacklist subcontractor safety PTW 是否建立承包商安全评价与准入制度？ 开工前是否强制专项安全培训或技术交底？ 是否有作业票、现场巡检等过程监督？ 违章问责或黑名单机制是什么？ 机制覆盖多少外包作业或承包商单位？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '承包商安全管理'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否建立承包商安全评价与准入制度？ 开工前是否强制专项安全培训或技术交底？ 是否有作业票、现场巡检等过程监督？ 违章问责或黑名单机制是什么？ 机制覆盖多少外包作业或承包商单位？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有企业自身ISO 45001认证；仅有“要求承包商注意安全”；仅有供应商环境标准；仅有一般采购合同模板；区分：承包商安全管理聚焦外包方安全准入、培训、监督与问责；ISO 45001是企业自身体系认证；供应商行为准则/道德采购更广，需单独抽出安全条款才可作为本指标证据。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: Quality and Reliable Service / ‧ Improving terminal security
results.text: Terminal security is a major focus area of the Group for maintaining the security of shipping containers and cargoes. To control security risks and cargo safety, we set up security infrastructures and deploy security teams at the cargo terminals. In the cargo terminals, site perimeter fencing, security gates, security lighting are installed. The check-in and check-out processes of personnel and vehicles are strictly guarded as well as the site patrolling. Moreover, the security of terminals is monitored by installing the surveillance cameras system.

results.section: Safety and Health / Passenger and Crew Safety
results.text: The Group has a strong responsibility towards our passengers and employees to ensure safety on ferries and ships. We have formulated and implemented the Safety Management Manual for Ships and other standards and guidelines to guide employees on daily maintenance and inspection to ensure the proper functioning and safe operation of ferries and ships. We also provide instructions on how to manage and respond to scenarios such as severe weather conditions and fires to subsidiaries under the passenger transportation business, so as to eliminate potential risks and ensure safe operation of ferries, ships and cruise ship. In order to enhance the contingency preparedness and situational awareness of the subsidiaries under the passenger transportation business, we conduct emergency exercises simulation exercises are regularly conducted such as spill collision, stranding of ferry and hull damage simulation. Safety training is carried out periodically to foster a safety awareness culture and to ensure that the Group's safety standards are communicated effectively. During the Reporting Period, there was no case of significant safety accident in passenger transportation.

results.section: People-oriented Workplace / Safety and Health
results.text: The Group provides adequate and personal protective equipment to employees based on their nature of work. Understanding fatigue can affect employees' health, safety and work performance, the Group prevents fatigue accidents in the workplace by establishing reasonable work arrangements to avoid excessively long shifts. In addition, the Group provides employees with common rooms, and adequate breaks for them to take rest. To protect our drivers' health, the Group installs air cushions in the driver's cab of terminal tractors for shock absorption, providing greater comfort and stability while reducing drivers' spinal stress when driving.

results.section: Quality and Reliable Service / Valuing Customer Privacy and Persistence in Information Accuracy
results.text: The Group has been trying to incorporate the sustainable practice into its supply chain management. We seek to work with suppliers who share the same value with us. Apart from evaluating the cost, reputation and delivery of potential suppliers' products and services, the Group also considers their social and environmental performances, such as product and service quality, ethical conduct and environmental conservation. Taking Sun Ferry as an example, Sun Ferry has stipulated its ESG requirements for suppliers in a Supplier Code of Conduct , and favours suppliers who could demonstrate commitments to uphold sustainability principles listed in the code during suppliers' selection process.
